question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **based**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Based **means founded on or having a foundation in something. (किसी चीज़ पर स्थापित या आधारित होना)

 
 
• **For example**: *The company's decision was based on market research.*
 
 
 
• In the sentence, "**based**" indicates that something has been formed or determined primarily from the perspective, knowledge, or influence of a single person.
 
• It implies that the outcome is closely tied to that person's input or perspective.

Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.

Complete passage: *Redwing had read (1) somewhere__ that one of his favourite writers, Ernest Hemingway, had been asked what was the best (2) __training __for a novelist. He had said "an unhappy childhood". Redwing had enjoyed a fine time growing up, but he (3) __wondered __if this whole (4) __expedition __was unfolding more like a novel, and would be **(5) **__**based** __on one person, one character, the guy in charge: him. Maybe you got a happy childhood and then an unhappy adulthood, and that's how novels worked.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bloomed **means to produce flowers or to come into full development. (फूल पैदा करना या पूर्ण विकास में आना)
 
• **Blessed **means to be made holy or to be given divine favour. (पवित्र बनाया जाना या दैवीय अनुग्रह दिया जाना)
 
• **Blamed **means to hold responsible or accountable for something. (किसी चीज़ के लिए जिम्मेदार या जवाबदेह ठहराना)
